game.name: Motogp '06 (USA, Europe)(En,Fr,De,Es,It)
game.desc:
MotoGP 06 is the 2006 installment of THQ's motorcycle racing series, having all the season data accurate for the year.
Gameplay is of similar type to its predecessors, being very tight controls with gameplay that relies heavily on skill and not known for its forgivingness. The game includes 17 GP tracks as well as 17 faster, less technical (and also fictional) "Extreme" tracks. Some of the modes available are typical racing types, with Career, Stunt and Practice being a few.
The updates to the game in this particular case are refined controls, updated graphics to bring the game up to par with the capabilities of the 360, new bikes and racers and quite importantly a heavily re-worked and refined Live play mode, which supports up to 16 players in a race on either the "GP" or "Extreme" tracks.
